Aadhaar No. uses the existing students.uid field. Exactly 12 digits are accepted; no new database column is created.

Teacher & Subject Allocation

Assign a teacher to a class + section + subject. This becomes the source for timetable teacher selection and staff result/marks access.

A teacher can enter/edit marks only for the class + section + subject allocated here. The same assignment is written to the existing staff_result_permissions table used by Staff mobile login.
EmployeeTeacherClassSectionSubjectEdit Marks
School Timetable

Unified weekly timetable: Class + Section on the left and Periods across the top. Each period cell contains Subject, Teacher and Days. All is the default; choose specific days when required. The same teacher may use the same period on different days; only same-day, same-period clashes are blocked.

Unified Timetable: one timetable for the whole week. Each period has Subject, Teacher and Days. All is selected by default; if a period applies only on particular days, select Monday–Saturday in that cell. Teacher clash checking is day-wise, so the same teacher may use the same period on different days.
Working days are selected inside each timetable box. Default: All.
Each cell contains Subject and Teacher/Staff. Subjects come from the class subject allotment. The Teacher dropdown contains the full active staff list for every class and subject. Timetable is the primary assignment screen; saving it synchronizes Teacher & Subject Allocation and Staff Result permissions.

Admin & Users

Manage user accounts and assign Portal Role inside the active school only. Staff who create/activate an account from the login page are automatically added here as Teacher. Administrator, Principal and Academic Manager can change roles.

UsernameStaff / User NamePortal RoleAssociated IDPermission ModeActions
Role-based jobs: each Portal Role has its own menu/sub-menu permissions. New staff logins start as Teacher; Administrator, Principal and Academic Manager can change a user's role, and the selected role's menu/sub-menu permissions control access. View: user can open/see the menu or sub tab. Edit: user can enter, save, update, delete or otherwise modify data. Edit automatically includes View.
Menu checkbox: checked = all sub menus selected; indeterminate = custom sub-menu selection; unchecked = menu disabled and all sub-menu View boxes disabled.
Navigation Sync: every main left-menu/submenu item is automatically included here for permission allotment.
